title: Two-Person List · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Two-Person List · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and two broad categories. Each player names one different example in each category. The group agrees all four examples fit the assigned categories. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Two-Person List, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees all four examples fit the assigned categories.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees all four examples fit the assigned categories.
